claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and appropriate PEEP.
Wean inspired oxygen fraction as tolerated to maintain SpO2 92-96%, avoiding hyperoxia.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate to assess oxygenation, ventilation, and perfusion.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose monitoring, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; transfuse packed red blood cells if hemoglobin falls below 7-8 g/dL or if there is evidence of active bleeding or ischemia.
Continue potassium replacement and monitor serum potassium, targeting normokalemia.
Continue vancomycin and cefazolin as prescribed; monitor renal function and vancomycin levels.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, using opioids judiciously and monitoring sedation and respiratory status.
Perform daily sedation interruption and assess readiness for extubation.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as indicated.
